```{r}
Sys.setenv(PATH = paste("home/fadikar/softwares/anaconda3/condabin", Sys.getenv("PATH"), sep = ":"))

source(paste0(r_path, "/odin-sim.R"))
source(paste0(r_path, "/adaptive_TS.R"))


## user input
init_npar <- 5
nrep <- 20
sim_budget <- 300
grid_npar <- 100
nTS_samp <- 10
GP_type <- "CRNGP"
err_sig <- 0.5
prop_sig <- 0.3

## Create ground truth
par_true <- c(0.45, 0.35, 50)
xtrue <- par_true[1:2]
strue <- par_true[3]
ytrue <- run_sim(c(xtrue, strue))
ytrue_full <- ytrue$n_SI
ytrue_vec <- ytrue_full

sim_func <- run_sim_err
p <- 2
ref <- -2
```


## Using normalizing flow

```{r}
## =====================
## initial design and simulations
set.seed(1)
X_01 <- lhs::randomLHS(n = init_npar, k = p)
s <- 1:nrep
Xs_01 <- cbind(X_01[rep(1:init_npar, each = nrep), ], rep(s, init_npar))

simouts <- list() # store full simulations so we don't have to re-run later in the analysis
y <- rep(NA, init_npar*nrep)
for (ii in 1:(init_npar*nrep)){
  simout <- sim_func(Xs_01[ii,])
  y[ii] <- simout$out
  simouts[[ii]] <- simout$res
}

## =====================
## standardize output
y_std <- scale(log(y))
ycenter <- attr(y_std, "scaled:center")
ysd <- attr(y_std, "scaled:scale")


## =====================
## BO set up 
Xs <- Xs_01
Y <- y_std
f <- fitGP(Xs, Y, GP_type = GP_type, known = list(beta0 = 0))

no_of_sims <- length(y)
X_list <- list()
y_list <- list()
simout_list <- list()
ynative_list <- list()

X_list[[1]] <- Xs_01
y_list[[1]] <- y_std
simout_list[[1]] <- simouts
ynative_list[[1]] <- y
```

```{r}
# TS starts here
tt <- 2
while(no_of_sims < sim_budget){
# for (tt in 1:nTS_iter){
  
  
  grid <- create_grid_flow_CRNGP(grid_npar,
                            nrep,
                            model = f,
                            ref,
                            err_sig)
  # Xsgrid <- grid
  # Xsgrid <- grid[[1]]
  # Xsgrid_full <- grid[[2]]
  # Xsgrid_id <- grid[[3]]
  
  ## predict
  # pred <- predict(model, Xsgrid, xprime = Xsgrid)
  # tTS <- MASS::mvrnorm(n = nTS_samp, 
  #                      mu = pred$mean, Sigma = 1/2 * (pred$cov + t(pred$cov)))
  # 
  # best_ids <- apply(tTS, 1, which.min)
  # best_ids <- unique(best_ids)
  out <- next_eval_CRN(model = f,
                       grid_npar = grid_npar,
                       nrep = nrep,
                       ref = ref,
                       err_sig = err_sig,
                       prop_sig = prop_sig,
                       nTS_samp = nTS_samp,
                       adaptive = T)
  
  xnew <- out
  if(!is.matrix(xnew)) xnew <- matrix(xnew, nrow = 1)
  
  ## evaluate new simulations 
  ynew <- rep(NA, nrow(xnew))
  simouts <- list()
  for (ii in 1:nrow(xnew)){
    simout <- sim_func(xnew[ii, ])
    ynew[ii] <- simout$out
    simouts[[ii]] <- simout$res
  }
  X_list[[tt]] <- xnew
  y_list[[tt]] <- (log(ynew) - ycenter) / ysd
  ynative_list[[tt]] <- ynew
  simout_list[[tt]] <- simouts
  
  ## update surrogate
  Xs <- rbind(Xs, xnew)
  Y <- c(Y, y_list[[tt]])
  f <- fitGP(Xs, Y, GP_type = GP_type, 
             known = list(beta0 = 0))
  
  no_of_sims <- no_of_sims + length(ynew)
  
  cat("iter = ", tt, "\n")
  
  tt <- tt + 1
}
```

```{r}
threshold <- -1

# ---- Function to compute cumulative proportion ----
get_cum_prop <- function(lst, threshold, method_name) {
  vals <- unlist(lst, use.names = FALSE)
  data.frame(
    eval_num = seq_along(vals),
    proportion_below = cumsum(vals <= threshold) / seq_along(vals),
    method = method_name
  )
}

df1 <- get_cum_prop(y_list_flow, threshold, "Flow")
df2 <- get_cum_prop(y_list_mh, threshold, "MH")

df_all <- rbind(df1, df2)

# ---- Plot ----
ggplot(df_all, aes(x = eval_num, y = proportion_below, color = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Proportion of trajectories ≤", threshold),
    x = "Budget",
    y = "Cumulative Proportion Below Threshold",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
get_cum_prop_iter <- function(lst, threshold, method_name) {
  total_evals <- cumsum(lengths(lst))
  cum_below <- cumsum(sapply(lst, function(x) sum(x <= threshold)))
  data.frame(
    total_evals = total_evals,
    proportion_below = cum_below / total_evals,
    method = method_name
  )
}

df1_iter <- get_cum_prop_iter(y_list_flow, threshold, "Flow")
df2_iter <- get_cum_prop_iter(y_list_mh, threshold, "MH")

df_all_iter <- rbind(df1_iter, df2_iter)

ggplot(df_all_iter, aes(x = total_evals, y = proportion_below, color = method)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Comparison After Each BO Iteration – ≤", threshold),
    x = "Total Number of Function Evaluations",
    y = "Cumulative Proportion Below Threshold",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}

# ---- Helper Function ----
make_df <- function(values_list, X_list, method_name, threshold) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(values_list), function(i) {
    df <- as.data.frame(X_list[[i]])              # convert matrix -> data frame
    colnames(df) <- paste0("x", seq_len(ncol(df))) # ensure column names x1, x2, ...
    df$value <- values_list[[i]]
    df$below_threshold <- df$value <= threshold
    df$method <- method_name
    df
  }))
}

df_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  make_df(y_list_flow, X_list_flow, "Flow", threshold),
  make_df(y_list_mh, X_list_mh, "MH", threshold)
)

head(df_all)

ggplot(subset(df_all, below_threshold == TRUE), aes(x = x1, y = x2, color = method, shape = method)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = data.frame(x1 = ground_truth["x1"], x2 = ground_truth["x2"]),
             aes(x = x1, y = x2),
             color = "black", shape = 1, size = 5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Candidate Points (Threshold =", threshold, ")"),
    x = "x1", y = "x2",
    color = paste("≤", threshold),
    shape = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

thresholds <- c(-3, -1, 0)

# ---- Function to compute cumulative proportions for any threshold ----
get_cum_prop_multi <- function(lst, thresholds, method_name) {
  vals <- unlist(lst, use.names = FALSE)
  eval_num <- seq_along(vals)
  
  do.call(rbind, lapply(thresholds, function(th) {
    data.frame(
      eval_num = eval_num,
      proportion_below = cumsum(vals <= th) / eval_num,
      method = method_name,
      threshold = paste0("≤ ", th)
    )
  }))
}

df_all <- rbind(
  get_cum_prop_multi(y_list_flow, thresholds, "Flow"),
  get_cum_prop_multi(y_list_mh, thresholds, "MH")
)

# ---- Plot with facets ----
ggplot(df_all, aes(x = eval_num, y = proportion_below, color = method)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  facet_wrap(~threshold) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of Methods Across Multiple Thresholds",
    x = "Number of Function Evaluations",
    y = "Cumulative Proportion Below Threshold",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
